NATIVE: standard German as written in Germany (de-DE)
register: du everywhere, infinitive on buttons, German quotes „…“ in German text and straight quotes for English, never Austrian or Swiss words
pron: IPA between slashes with ˈ stress, written exactly like the Chinese, Portuguese, French and Italian courses
a_extra: This file set is written by a careful writer on purpose: in two earlier courses the deck notes were the weakest part. Every card note must be written for German speakers; if a note reasons from Spanish (or carries advice that only makes sense for Spanish speakers), replace it. Meanings must be idiomatic German, never word-for-word glosses.
i_extra: German words are long: the seven tab labels must each be ≤ 8 characters (use the profile's short labels) and button labels should prefer short verbs. The settings label for `Text size` must be very short (e.g. «Schrift»).
